Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 0004–0022 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. Route 24 and Nugget Bridge are converted. Route 25 and Bill are the next development area. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Nugget Bridge has Yellow’s five contest teams and levels, its Nugget reward and Rocket recruitment battle, the optional grass trainer, level-10 Charmander gift and reusable TM45 Thunder Wave. Grass uses Yellow’s species and levels at every time of day. Make room in your party before accepting Charmander. Blue stops all bridge approach lanes at the correct height. Mt. Moon’s fossils now render as items without the extra figure; the fossil guard battle is automatic, and Jessie/James visibly approach from the left side of the exit for their mandatory ambush. Earlier features and normal save progress carry forward; use Continue and keep a backup. Johto terrain is unchanged. Earlier patch pages remain available separately.
